profile_text.body:
Otter.ai is a software company that provides AI-powered meeting transcription and note-taking tools. Its core product, the Otter AI Meeting Agent, offers real-time transcription, live chat during meetings, automated summaries, and action item extraction. The company describes itself as recognized by the Wall Street Journal as a must-try AI tool, and its OtterPilot product is presented as an AI meeting assistant. Users can capture meetings automatically via a bot, through a desktop or Chrome recorder, or on mobile, and a connected Otter AI Chat feature searches across meetings and linked applications to answer questions and help generate follow-ups, reports, and other content.

Otter.ai also offers an MCP Server that allows external AI tools, including ChatGPT and Claude, to access meeting content for analysis and workflow integration. The company's product is categorized in the notes, knowledge, and meetings space, with consent noted as a relevant consideration given its transcription functionality. No litigation or SEC filings are reflected in the held facts.
